page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores using the x86_64 architecture, specifically utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage options and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.g7.8xlarge in the average performance tier for most compute and memory tasks, with some notable strengths. The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 (AVX512F and AVX512_VNNI) and cryptographic acceleration (AES, VAES, SHA_NI). In testing, the instance achieved a Passmark CPU score of 36,598.86 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 13,329.0. Its memory subsystem demonstrated strong performance in the Passmark memory test, scoring 2,775.46, which places it in the top 25% tier. This is supported by a cached read-only memory bandwidth of 1,699.39 GB/sec.

The instance's balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it highly cost-efficient for general-purpose enterprise workloads that require dedicated compute resources without the premium of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. It is appropriate for applications such as static web serving, where it achieved a throughput of 33.08 GB/sec, and database operations, processing 31.4 million Redis SET operations per second. Additionally, its CPU capabilities support moderate machine learning tasks, demonstrating a strong text generation speed of 304.16 tokens per second using a small 135M LLM model.
